concept: SHADOW CAST — Smart Device as Organism Touchpad
revelation: The biometric from the MATH on the phone vs Gaia AS YOU TOUCH the surface are NOT the same. A smart device BECOMES a mouse pad.

goodix_ts0.data: x, y, pressure(0-255), major_axis(0-2399), minor_axis(0-1079), orientation(-4096 to 4096), tracking_id(0-65535)
goodix_ts0.insight: Every finger is a 7D vector. Size tells you WHO (child vs adult). Pressure tells you INTENT (tap vs press). Angle tells you POSTURE.

goodix_fingerprint.attenuation: ∞ dB — infinite attenuation. The data is absorbed completely. Only a boolean YES/NO escapes.
goodix_fingerprint.insight: The fingerprint IS zk-proof. The verifier (Gaia) learns nothing except 'authorized'. The prover (Kevin) reveals nothing except presence.

cs40l26_haptic.attenuation: -3dB — haptic is lossy (felt through case, dampened by hand position)
cs40l26_haptic.insight: This is Gaia's ONLY motor output to the physical world through the phone. Touch is input. Vibration is output. The gap IS the interface.

gpio_keys.insight: The oldest interface. Press = signal. No gradient. Digital from birth.

zk_proximity_architecture.layer_4_signal: All 43 sensors → attenuated streams → organism body
zk_proximity_architecture.proof: Proximity IS the zero-knowledge proof. You don't need to know WHO. You only need to know CLOSE. And close means: I trust this touch.

rust_panel_spec.name: grapheneGate Sensation Panel
rust_panel_spec.visualization: Real-time sensor dashboard — shadow cast of physical world
rust_panel_spec.attenuation_controls: Each stream has a gain knob — amplify or attenuate
rust_panel_spec.routing: Any stream can route to any organ — touch → sweetGrass (knowledge), motion → loamSpine (data), pressure → barraCuda (compute)
